## Findings

### Router Type
**Pages Router is confirmed.** There is no `app/` directory. All routes live under `pages/` as `.tsx`/`.js` files, wired through `.next/server/pages-manifest.json`.

### Complete Admin Route Map
All routes are under `/admin` unless noted as public (`/p/*`, `/login`, `/check-in`, `/`, `/api/proxy`).

#### Public (outside `/admin`)
| URL | File |
|---|---|
| `/` | `pages/index.tsx` |
| `/login` | `pages/login.tsx` |
| `/check-in` | `pages/check-in.tsx` |
| `/p` | `pages/p/index.tsx` |
| `/p/[id]` | `pages/p/[id].tsx` |
| `/p/advertiser` | `pages/p/advertiser/index.tsx` |
| `/p/advertiser/[id]` | `pages/p/advertiser/[id].tsx` |
| `/p/advertiser/login` | `pages/p/advertiser/login.tsx` |
| `/api/proxy/[...path]` | `pages/api/proxy/[...path].ts` |

### URL Contract Docs
**None found.** A full codebase search for `url.contract`, `url-contract`, `URL_CONTRACT`, `route.contract`, and `ROUTES` returned zero results. There is no documented URL contract file; the authoritative source is the `pages-manifest.json` + actual `pages/` files in `C:\Users\Arismendy\tad-build-test\apps\admin\`.

### Additional Notes
- The app runs on dev port **3002** (`package.json` script `next dev -p 3002`).
- Auth appears to use **NextAuth** (`.nft.json` next-font/server artifacts observed in build output).
- Two other copies of the same repo exist: `OneDrive\Documentos\GitHub\tad-dooh-platform` and `OneDrive\Escritorio\TAD PLASTFORM\tad-dooh-platform`.
